provenance.availability_semantics: The source 'availability' field is a historical general-willingness label from the Kaggle dataset. It does NOT represent current operational availability or time-pressured emergency recruitment probability. Phase 2 classifier achieved near-chance performance (CV ROC-AUC=0.4959, Test ROC-AUC=0.4731), confirming limited predictive discrimination. A separate 'simulated_current_availability' field is generated synthetically for each simulation scenario.
provenance.response_propensity_semantics: synthetic_response_propensity is drawn from Beta(2,5), independent of the Kaggle availability label. It is used ONLY as hidden simulation ground truth for the StochasticResponseModel, never as a ranking input.
